$comment: Canonical engineering baseline for the @cosyte/* parser repos. scripts/drift-check.js fails when a repo diverges. The authoritative prose is the meta-repo documentation/conventions.md; this is its machine-checkable shadow. Until Phases D/E migrate each parser, drift here is EXPECTED. It is the worklist.
pnpmOverridesComment: Canonical pnpm.overrides every parser must carry; the rationale is Dependabot dev/build-time advisory remediation. esbuild: GHSA dev-server path-traversal (not reachable; repos build via tsup/vitest, never `esbuild serve`). js-yaml@4: GHSA-h67p-54hq-rp68 quadratic merge-key DoS, advisory range extended to <4.3.0, so the pin is 4.3.0 (bumped 2026-07-21). KNOWN RESIDUAL (not pinnable): js-yaml@3.14.2 reached via read-yaml-file@1.1.0 (@manypkg/get-packages → @changesets/cli) calls yaml.safeLoad, which throws in js-yaml 4, so it cannot be force-upgraded without breaking release tooling; it only parses trusted local repo YAML at release time.
phiScanProbeComment: Parameters for the one BEHAVIOURAL check in scripts/drift-check.js: it RUNS each repo's scripts/phi-scan.ts against a throwaway corpus and asks whether it refuses over a target it enumerated and never read. THE MACHINERY NOW LIVES IN @cosyte/script-utils/phi-scan, so the probe PLANTS that package into the throwaway repository before running, and WHICH copy it plants is the adoption check: the controls plant config's own working copy, a target repo is graded against the version THAT repo has installed, and a repo that has not adopted carries a self-contained scanner and needs nothing planted. A repo that HAS adopted but has no node_modules yields a scanner that cannot start, prints no marker, and lands on `inconclusive` rather than on a pass. It is a capability probe, never a regex over the scanner's source: this class has produced six defects that lived in a prose carrier while the code was right, so matching prose would grade the comment. NOTHING HERE NAMES AN EXIT CODE, deliberately. The siblings do not agree on their codes, so the probe derives each repo's HITS code from a control run and treats only exit 0 as `reported clean`. A perRepo entry exists for a repo whose scanner does not read the default fixture (dicom tiers by EXTENSION), and the probe answers `inconclusive` rather than passing when it cannot ground its own premise.

dicom.$why: dicom's text pass detects DICOM's own shapes (a PN token, a recent date), not a dashed SSN, so the default payload scanned CLEAN there and the probe answered `inconclusive` rather than passing. The payload below is a synthetic PN. Measured 2026-08-11.
